> *This script runs a standardized principal component analysis (`rasterPCA`) on a stacked raster of environmental predictors (bathymetry, slope, distance to shore, SST, SSS, Chl); exports each individual PC (1-3) as a mapped PNG + exports biplots (PC1×PC2, PC1×PC3, PC2×PC3) showing point scores with variable loading vectors*

> **𖠺 Created by Keiley Gregory on March 17, 2026**
>
> **Last updated on July 20, 2026**

*SEARCH "#‼️" TO FIND LINES WHERE FILE PATHS NEED TO BE CHANGED FOR CURRENT MISSION*

```{r}
library(RStoolbox)
library(raster)  # RStoolbox requires raster objects not terra
library(ggplot2) # for biplot
library(ggrepel)
```

Import `maxent_env_stack_1km_UTM20N.tif` + convert terra stack to raster for RStoolbox *(`rast()` needs `terra` package)*

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
env_stack <- terra::rast("/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/6_data_analysis_outputs/maxent_model/LF_maxent_model/1_env_stack_output/maxent_env_stack_1km_UTM20N.tif")
```

# PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (PCA)

```{r}
pca_result <- rasterPCA(env_stack, nComp = 3, spca = TRUE)
summary(pca_result$model)

# loadings (which variables drive each PC)
pca_result$model$loadings
```

**Plot [individual]{.underline} principal components (PC1, PC2, and PC3)**

```{r}
plot(pca_result$map[[1]], main = "PC1")
plot(pca_result$map[[2]], main = "PC2")
plot(pca_result$map[[3]], main = "PC3")
```

Export plots of individual PCs as PNG files

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
for (i in 1:3) {
  png(paste0("/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/6_data_analysis_outputs/maxent_model/LF_maxent_model/2_pca_output/pca_pc", i, ".png"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
  plot(pca_result$map[[i]], main = paste0("PC", i))
  dev.off()
}
```

> [*Summary of PC variables*]{.underline}
>
> - ***PC1 = 40.4%, PC2 = 25.9%, PC3 = 13.1%** (from `Proportion of Variance` row in output `Importance of components` table)*
> - ***PCs 1–3 cumulatively explain 79.5 % of variance** (from `Cumulative Proportion` row x `Comp. 3` column in output `Importance of components` table)*

# PCA BIPLOTS

Extract all three PC scores

```{r}
scores <- data.frame(
  Comp.1 = as.vector(raster::values(pca_result$map[[1]])),
  Comp.2 = as.vector(raster::values(pca_result$map[[2]])),
  Comp.3 = as.vector(raster::values(pca_result$map[[3]]))
)
scores <- na.omit(scores)
```

Sample once (used for all biplots)

```{r}
set.seed(42)
scores_sample <- scores
scale_factor <- 3

# if want to subset points to 2,000 pts for plot (so grey pts are not as dense)
#set.seed(42)
#idx <- sample(nrow(scores), 2000)
#scores_sample <- scores[idx, ]
#scale_factor <- 3
```

### PC1 x PC2 BIPLOT

Loadings for biplot *(ignore `Error in .rs.exprMutatesPackageLibrary(part)`...)*

```{r}
loadings_df12 <- as.data.frame(pca_result$model$loadings[, 1:2])
colnames(loadings_df12) <- c("Comp.1", "Comp.2")
loadings_df12$variable <- rownames(loadings_df12)

# customize spacing in plot (bathy, slope, dist_shore, SST, SSS, Chl_log)
#loadings_df12$nudge_x <- c(0.2, 0.2, -0.3, -0.2, 0.2, -0.3)
#loadings_df12$nudge_y <- c(0.2, -0.2, 0.2, 0.05, 0, -0.15)
```

**Create manual biplot for PC1 and PC2**

```{r}
p_pc1pc2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(data = scores_sample, aes(x = Comp.1, y = Comp.2),
             shape = 1, color = "grey50", alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings_df12,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                   xend = Comp.1 * scale_factor,
                   yend = Comp.2 * scale_factor),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "open"),
               color = "blue", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_label_repel(data = loadings_df12,
                   aes(x = Comp.1 * scale_factor,
                       y = Comp.2 * scale_factor,
                       label = variable),
                   color = "blue", size = 3, fontface = "bold",
                   fill = "#ebf2ff", label.size = 0.15,
                   label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
                   #nudge_x = loadings_df12$nudge_x, # customized spacing from above code
                   #nudge_y = loadings_df12$nudge_y, # customized spacing from above code
                   segment.color = NA,
                   max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(title = "PCA Biplot (PC1 and PC2)",
       #‼️‼️ UPDATE PC % VALUES FOR CURRENT MISSION/FREQUENCY
       x = "PC1 (40.4%)", y = "PC2 (25.9%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

p_pc1pc2
```

Export PC1-PC2 biplot as PNG

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
png("/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/6_data_analysis_outputs/maxent_model/LF_maxent_model/2_pca_output/pca_biplot_pc1_pc2.png", width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 500)
print(p_pc1pc2)
dev.off()
```
